cohort: Very preterm births between 22+0 and 31+6 weeks of gestation in 19 regions from 11 European countries participating in the EPICE project in 2011/2012
finding: While the prevalence of very preterm triplets varies across European regions, most triplets are born via cesarean section, and those born vaginally had lower Apgar scores; overall in-hospital mortality after live birth was similar to singletons and twins.
mod_finding: Most triplets were delivered by cesarean section, and those born vaginally had lower Apgar scores.
gest_age: Very preterm (22+0 and 31+6 weeks of gestation)
